فَقْحَةٌ : see فُقَّاحٌ. ―
-b2- Also The anus: (S, K:) because it opens in the case of need: (Ham p. 677:) or a wide, or an ample, anus: (K, MF:) or a wide دُبُر: or a دُبُر with what it comprises: and afterwards, by reason of frequency of usage, applied to signify any دُبُر: (L:) pl. فِقَاحٌ. (S, K.) ―
-b3- And The palm of the hand; as also ↓ فَقَاحَةٌ : (K:) of the dial. of El-Yemen: so called because of its width. (TA.) ―
-b4- And The napkin (مِنْدِيل) of الإِحْرَام [i. e., which is used by one performing the rites of the حَجّ or of the عُمْرَة]: (K:) of the dial. of El-Yemen. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
